rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version assigns cpu = cpumask_first(mask) before passing cpu to alloc_buffer(), whereas the vulnerable version passes the loop variable after the path-setup loop. The Logic section does not specify which CPU value is supplied to buffer allocation, nor any equivalent selection or validation rule. Its statements about allocation, sink retrieval, work initialization, path setup, failure cleanup, and the returned event-data structure hold on both versions.
